authorization: User requested training on supplied 200 speech and 100 violence clips
label_policy: Speech: user-reported weak clip labels, not human-verified segment labels. Violence: verified author labels.
split_policy: Speech source-ID + exact SHA + transitive dHash candidate groups; 11 exposed clips forced into train; balance labels only
independent_test_caveat: User previously tried an unknown number of clips. Source groups are provisional, speakers may overlap; not blind gold evaluation.
violence_policy: All AIRTLab100 repurposed to training as one group; previous external metrics remain historical only. RLVS train/valid/test unchanged.

asr.caveat: GPU FP16 transcripts may differ from the CPU INT8 app; no claim of production CPU pipeline accuracy

toxic_training.objective: BCEWithLogitsLoss on max(segment positive-minus-negative logit) per clip; no inherited positive label for every segment
toxic_training.missing_asr: Exclude from probabilistic fitting/metrics and report coverage; retain missing as null
toxic_training.selection: Validation only: precision and recall >= baseline when possible, then macro-F1, F1, lower log loss, earlier epoch; 0.05..0.95 thresholds
toxic_training.rules: Frozen hybrid lexicon unchanged; rules not used to manufacture labels

violence_training.representation: frozen R3D18 temporal mean/max, same as v3
violence_training.selection: RLVS validation only: FP <= baseline and recall >= baseline if feasible, then macro-F1/F1
violence_training.test: Previously reported RLVS test386, never used in selection; AIRTLab metric is training only

deployment: Save candidates separately; do not replace active artifacts automatically based on weak-label evaluation
